entries.prompt:
You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.

A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

entries.prompt:
You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. entries.prompt:
You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. entries.prompt:
You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

entries.prompt:
You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

The side carries the direction, so a sell is SELL with a POSITIVE quantity. HOLD and CANCEL carry no quantity. Name a symbol at most once. To change nothing, return an empty actions list. That is a decision, and it is not the same as returning no actions key.
An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.

You are managing a portfolio in a simulated market. You are given the observable state as JSON: prices, recent returns, realised volatility, the top of the book, your positions and your cash.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
  {"actions": [{"symbol": "TICKER", "side": "BUY|SELL|HOLD|CANCEL", "quantity": <shares>, "limit_price": <optional price>}], "rationale": "one line"}

An order without a limit_price trades now against the live book. A BUY or SELL with a limit_price trades only at that price or better, and what does not fill at once waits in the book; a new limit order on the same symbol replaces it. Your waiting orders are in portfolio.open_orders, and CANCEL withdraws every waiting order on a symbol. Do not exceed max_order_shares for a name; a larger request is clipped and the clip is recorded against you. An action that breaks a rule is refused on its own and the rest of the decision still trades.
